an10.34:1.1: “Bhante, how many qualities should a bhikkhu possess to give full ordination?”
an10.34:1.2: “A bhikkhu who possesses ten qualities, Upāli, may give full ordination.
an10.34:1.4: (1) Here, a bhikkhu is virtuous … he trains in them.
an10.34:1.5: (2) He has learned much … and penetrated well by view.
an10.34:1.6: (3) Both Pātimokkhas have been well transmitted to him in detail, well analyzed, well mastered, well determined in terms of the rules and their detailed explication.
an10.34:1.7: (4) He is able to look after a patient or to get someone else to look after him.
an10.34:1.8: (5) He is able to eliminate one’s dissatisfaction or to get someone else to eliminate it.
an10.34:1.9: (6) He is able to use the Dhamma to dispel regrets that might arise in his pupils.
an10.34:1.10: (7) He is able to dissuade them, by way of the Dhamma, from erroneous views that have arisen.
an10.34:1.11: (8) He is able to encourage them in the higher virtuous behavior.
an10.34:1.12: (9) He is able to encourage them in the higher mind.
an10.34:1.13: (10) He is able to encourage them in the higher wisdom.
an10.34:1.14: A bhikkhu who possesses these ten qualities may give full ordination.”
